content.en: The **Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC)** project is a strategic initiative by the Government of India to create high-capacity, high-speed railway corridors. By separating freight traffic from passenger traffic, the DFC aims to increase the average speed of goods trains, reduce transit times, and lower the overall **logistics cost** in the Indian economy. This infrastructure is vital for supporting the 'Make in India' initiative and enhancing the efficiency of the **National Logistics Policy**.
